description.zh:
业务类型。取值：
- 0：本机号码认证。
- 1：一键登录。
> 因业务流程优化，减少了客户端鉴权接口的调用，本参数为**必填**。
description.en:
Business type. Valid values:

- 0: Native number verification.

- 1: One-click logon.

> This parameter is **required** due to flow optimizations that reduce client-side authentication calls.

description.zh: 请求源地址。请传入在控制台创建认证方案时填入的源地址，格式为“**协议 + // + 域名**”。
description.en: Origin URL. Enter the origin URL you specified when creating the authentication plan in the console. Format: **protocol + // + domain name**.

description.zh:
方案Code。

>  因方案升级，本参数为**必填**，请在控制台创建认证方案后传入方案Code，具体操作请参见[号码认证方案管理](~~615129~~)。
description.en:
Authentication plan code.

> This parameter is **required** due to plan upgrades. After creating an authentication plan in the console, pass its code. For details, see [Plan Management](~~615129~~).

description.zh:
请求页面地址。请传入在控制台创建认证方案时填入的页面地址，格式为“**协议 + // + 域名 + /**”。

> 测试可暂时传入公网IP地址，正式上线请使用域名。
description.en:
URL of the request page. Enter the URL you specified when creating the authentication plan in the console. Format: **protocol + // + domain name + /**.

> For testing, you can temporarily use a public IP address. Use a domain name for production.

title.zh: 获取 H5 认证授权 Token

descriptions.zh:
### 准备工作
请先完成阿里云账号注册、获取阿里云访问密钥、创建认证方案，更多信息，请参见[H5本机号码校验使用流程](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnvs/getting-started/h5-page-integration)。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### Preparations

You can register an Alibaba Cloud account, obtain an AccessKey pair, and create an authentication plan before you begin. For more information, see [H5 Native Number Verification Integration Flow](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnvs/getting-started/h5-page-integration).

### QPS limit

The per-user QPS limit for this operation is 1000 calls per second. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your business. Call this operation only as needed.
